title: Name change calls a missing route and silently ignores the failure
expected: Changing the display name updates every stored copy of the person's name, or the second call is removed.
actual: display_name is updated via /api/profiles/me/upsert; the follow-up PUT /api/auth/update-name always 404s and is swallowed by .catch(() => {}), so users.full_name keeps the old value.
impact: Two different names can exist for one person; where users.full_name is used (e.g. emails, admin views) the old name appears. Exact downstream effect to verify in Wave 3.
fix: Decide which field is the source of truth. Either add an authenticated, validated endpoint that updates users.full_name, or remove the dead call and derive the name from user_profiles everywhere.
